title: Factor advance state
statement: Given natural numbers $C,e,i$ and a Boolean flag $o$, define the state to be the factor-increment state with counter $i$ when $i$ is less than the complexity factor for $C,o$. Otherwise, define it to be the factor-test state for $o$.
